description: Reactive compliance offers limited notice explanation and collective remedy before harm occurs.
Adaptive systems provide stronger oversight but require clearer public explanation and remedy.
Rights-centered technology regulation emphasizes notice explanation appeal audit and remedy.
Climate regulation needs long-term remedies for delayed cumulative and uneven harm.
Sandbox safeguards require consent complaint channels exit conditions and compensation.
Participatory regulatory foresight improves remedy design through affected-person voice.
Captured innovation-first systems often leave affected people without meaningful remedy.
